committee_proposal_selection.principle: score proposals on a small random committee; evaluate only the selected query on all surviving candidates

continuous_non_enumerable.bridge: one-bit semantic output>scalar-reference query only for residual equivalence

unknown_task_observation_noise.method: candidate posterior plus candidate-specific Beta(1,9) observation-error posterior; true bit-flip rate is not supplied
unknown_task_observation_noise.conservative_threshold_control: threshold 0.9999 removed observed wrong routing at 30% noise in the matched screen, with a large unresolved increase

candidate_source_behavior_noise.negative: hard mismatch/majority scoring is unsafe when candidate source relation responses themselves are stochastic
candidate_source_behavior_noise.soft_likelihood: repeat source relation observations, convert each query to a smoothed predictive probability, accumulate candidate likelihoods instead of hard elimination
candidate_source_behavior_noise.decision: plugin/source registration should store a distribution over behavioral relations, not a single deterministic fingerprint

source_pool_scaling.family: continuous 2D linear directions with four positive-scale/offset gauge variants per direction
source_pool_scaling.relation: two-output order bit, invariant to positive scale+offset
source_pool_scaling.interpretation: relation query complexity tracks behavioral equivalence-class entropy; residual four-way gauge fixing remains exactly two bits

current_hypothesis: universal source identification should maximize gauge-invariant behavior, explicitly infer residual equivalence/gauge, and spend grounding only on that residual symmetry. Source-registration uncertainty must be represented probabilistically when plugins are stochastic.
claim_boundaries: continuous experiments use synthetic scalar functions and known input generators
order relations are invariant to strictly increasing output reparameterizations, not arbitrary output bijections
cross-modal scalar/reference predicates are real grounding channels
task-noise inference uses a low-noise Beta prior
candidate-source noise is injected at relation-bit level rather than full token/model stochasticity
next: learn a persistent probabilistic behavioral signature for stochastic neural plugins rather than estimating each relation independently
integrate black-box committee query synthesis with private-ABI neural sources
replace random continuous proposals with learned black-box query optimization
stress equivalence/gauge discovery when both task and candidate source observations are noisy
